newsitem.title: USA: Vitalcom sees Q4 operating loss.
newsitem.headline: Vitalcom sees Q4 operating loss.

text.p: VitalCom Inc said Tuesday it expects an operating loss in the fourth quarter based on a revenue forecast of about $3.4 million, down from $8.1 million a year ago.
Previously, the company said it expected fourth quarter revenue and operating results to fall below year-ago levels.
VitalCom, a maker of computer network products used by health care providers, said it continues to rebuild its sales pipeline and anticipates this effort will begin to mature in 1997.
VitalCom completed an initial public offering of stock in February 1996.

In September the company said longer sales cycles for its products, and changes in its sales and marketing organization would affect fourth quarter operating results. At that time, analysts had expected VitalCom to report a net profit of $0.09 a share in the quarter, according to First Call.
VitalCom said it expects to report fourth quarter results on February 10, following the completion of its annual audit.
